verdict: Leads surged at lower cost, but intake conversion needs immediate attention.
narrative: This period you received 92 leads from Meta at a 28-day cost of $23.84 per lead — and in the most recent week, leads jumped 52.94% on nearly flat spend, confirming the efficiency gain is real. That momentum has stabilised over the last few days rather than continuing to accelerate, so the current pace is solid but not yet a new normal. More urgently, 92 leads arrived over the last 28 days with zero progressing to a consultation or opportunity in your pipeline, meaning leads are coming in and going nowhere at intake — that is where focus is now. Your Google Business Profile also showed two consecutive days of zero activity this week, which is being investigated as a possible listing issue before it affects organic visibility.
